name: Getting Pregnant
overview: Scripture reveals that getting pregnant is a blessing from the Lord, as seen when Isaac prayed for his barren wife and God enabled Rebekah to conceive (Genesis 25:21). Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord, symbolizing His blessing and favor (Psalms 127:3). The Bible also portrays the joyful transformation of a barren woman into a mother who delights in her children (Psalms 113:9), emphasizing God's sovereign hand in granting life and sustaining His people (John 10:29). Serving the Lord faithfully invites His blessing and protection, which encompasses health and fruitfulness within the family (Exodus 23:25; Psalms 128:3).
